name: 420 Cannaseur / Attention
purpose: Opt-in attention economy for sponsor-funded campaigns and participant rewards denominated in native 420.
invariants: ATTN-INV-001: Participation is opt-in; no proof is accepted without active account or campaign consent.
ATTN-INV-002: Campaign media, raw behavioral telemetry and private audience data are not canonical on-chain state.
ATTN-INV-003: Campaign economics and audience-policy commitments are immutable after campaign creation.
ATTN-INV-004: Only the campaign-bound verifier may commit attention proofs for that campaign.
ATTN-INV-005: Proof nullifiers are single-use and fail closed on replay.
ATTN-INV-006: Proof observation time must fall inside an active campaign window.
ATTN-INV-007: Each proof can create at most one reward entitlement.
ATTN-INV-008: Per-account campaign rewards cannot exceed the immutable campaign cap.
ATTN-INV-009: Sponsor campaign funds are segregated liabilities inside AttentionTreasury and cannot be spent by generic governance treasury transfers.
ATTN-INV-010: A reward must be reserved against funded campaign balance before it can be claimed.
ATTN-INV-011: Reward release is single-use and can only pay the canonical participant account.
ATTN-INV-012: Unused sponsor funds can only be refunded after campaign close and after all reserved rewards are cleared.
ATTN-INV-013: Capability delegation is limited to consent management and reward claiming; it grants no custody, governance, bridge, validator or unrestricted smart-account authority.
ATTN-INV-014: Advertisers and verifiers never receive wallet keys or arbitrary transaction authority through the Attention protocol.
